intro: Kiribati has 33 coral islands in three groups spread across the central Pacific.

chapters.title: Three island groups
text: The Gilbert, Phoenix and Line Islands are far apart. Kiritimati (Christmas Island) is the largest coral atoll in the world by land area. The Phoenix Islands Protected Area is a World Heritage site.

chapters.title: Rising seas
text: Most land is only a few metres above sea level. Kiribati bought land in Fiji in 2014 as a possible future food source.

keyTerms.meaning: A ring of coral islands around a lagoon.
